skills.name: Expansion
skills.description: Nolan cuts a rectangular area in front of him with his cosmic gauge, dealing 230<font color='#D58E1F'>( +40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> and leaving a <font color='#404495'>(Rift)</font> at the first enemy hit.

skills.name: Gauge
skills.description: Nolan charges in the target direction and slashes with his cosmic gauge, dealing 70<font color='#D58E1F'>( +13% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies in his path and leaving a <font color='#404495'>(Rift)</font>.

skills.name: Fracture
skills.description: Nolan slashes the target location 3 times, dealing 120<font color='#D58E1F'>( +50% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> with each slash while leaving 3 rifts. The rifts will activate automatically while Nolan dashes backward.

skills.name: Dimensional Rift
skills.description:
Nolan's skills will leave a <font color='#404495'>(Rift)</font>. When a rift comes into contact with another rift, they will <font color='#404495'>(activate)</font> and pull enemies to their center and deal 220<font color='#D58E1F'>( +140% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> after a short delay. Each time a rift activation hits an enemy, Nolan will gain 15 Energy. If an enemy is hit by multiple rift activations, the damage after the first hit will be reduced by 40%.
<font color='#404495'>(Cosmic Leap)</font>: If Nolan does not deal or take damage for 5s, he enhances his next Basic Attack to dash to the target, dealing <font color='#D58E1F'>( +120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> and leaving a <font color='#404495'>(Rift)</font>. (Damage to and from Minions or Creeps will not prevent Nolan from getting this effect.)

items.name: Blade of the Heptaseas
items.des: Unique Passive - Ambush: If no damage is taken or dealt within 5s (excluding from Minions or Creeps), the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 160 <1025 0.4> Physical Damage and slow the target by 40% for 1.5s.

items.name: Ice Hunter's Magic Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Hunter: After dealing damage to a Creep, deal 25<2|lv 3> + <1005 0.01> True Damage to the target over 3s (damage is increased by 100% for non-Marksmen heroes).

items.name: Endless Battle
items.des: Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.des: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

items.name: Hunter Strike
items.des: Unique Passive - Retribution: Dealing damage to the same enemy hero or creep 5 times in a row grants 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 3s (8s cooldown).

items.name: Queen's Wings
items.des: Unique Passive - Demonize: When HP drops below 40%, gains 20% Damage Reduction and 35% extra Spell Vamp for 5s (60s cooldown).
